formal: variable.set(Name: variable = %path%, Value: text = "/", Default: bool = true)
variable.set(Name: variable = %!build.cache%, Value: bool = true, Default: bool = true)
variable.set(Name: variable = %!build.summary%, Value: bool = true, Default: bool = true)
channel.set(Name: text = "builder", Goal: action = goal.call(Name: goal = "BuilderChannel"))
goal.call(Name: goal = "EmitBuildEvent", Parameter: list = {kind: text = "build-path", path: item = %path%})
build.load(); variable.set(Name: variable = %app%, Value: item = %!data%)
build.goals(Path: path = %path%); variable.set(Name: variable = %goals%, Value: item = %!data%)
goal.call(Name: goal = "EmitBuildEvent", Parameter: list = {kind: text = "goals-found", goals: item = %goals%})
loop.foreach(Collection: item = %goals%); goal.call(Name: goal = "BuildGoal", Parameter: list = {goal: item = %item%})
file.save(Path: path = "/.build/traces/%!trace.id%/manifest.json", Value: item = %traceGoals%)
build.appSave()
condition.if(Left: item = %goal.IsCached%) { goal.return(Data: item = %goal.Cache%) }
goal.call(Name: goal = "/system/builder/EmitBuildEvent", Parameter: list = {kind: text = "goalHeader", goal: item = %goal%})
variable.set(Name: variable = %buildStart%, Value: item = %Now.Ticks%)
variable.set(Name: variable = %trace%, Value: text = "{\"id\": \"%!trace.id%\", \"timestamp\": \"%Now%\", \"goal\": \"%goal.Name%\", \"subGoals\": [], \"durationMs\": 0}")

text: call Compile, on error call HandleBuildFailure
formal: goal.call(Name: goal = "Compile"); on.error(Recovery: list<action> = [goal.call(Name: goal = "HandleBuildFailure")])
variable.set(Name: variable = %parentGoal%, Value: item = %goal%)
loop.foreach(Collection: item = %parentGoal.Child%); goal.call(Name: goal = "BuildSubGoal", Parameter: list = {subGoal: item = %item%})
variable.set(Name: variable = %goal%, Value: item = %parentGoal%)
math.subtract(A: item = %Now.Ticks%, B: item = %buildStart%); variable.set(Name: variable = %elapsedTicks%, Value: item = %!data%)
math.divide(A: item = %elapsedTicks%, B: number = 10000); variable.set(Name: variable = %elapsedMs%, Value: item = %!data%)
variable.set(Name: variable = %trace.durationMs%, Value: item = %elapsedMs%)
file.save(Path: path = "/.build/traces/%!trace.id%/%goal.Name%.json", Value: item = %trace%)
list.add(ListName: variable = %traceGoals%, Value: item = %goal.Name%)

text: build.fold Goal=%goal%, on error call HandleBuildFailure
formal: build.fold(Goal: goal = %goal%); on.error(Recovery: list<action> = [goal.call(Name: goal = "HandleBuildFailure")])
build.goalsSave(Goal: goal = %goal%)
variable.set(Name: variable = %threshold%, Value: number = 0.5)
variable.set(Name: variable = %modules%, Value: item = %!app.module.list%)
variable.set(Name: variable = %state.goal%, Value: item = %goal.Name%)
loop.foreach(Collection: item = %goal.Step%); goal.call(Name: goal = "AddStepToState", Parameter: list = {step: item = %item%})
loop.foreach(Collection: item = %modules%); goal.call(Name: goal = "AddModuleToState", Parameter: list = {module: item = %item%})
ui.render(Template: text = "/system/builder/llm/templates/deciderModuleQuestions.template"); variable.set(Name: variable = %moduleQuestions%, Value: item = %!data%)
llm.decider(State: text = "%state%", Question: dict = %moduleQuestions%); variable.set(Name: variable = %moduleAnswer%, Value: item = %!data%)
ui.render(Template: text = "/system/builder/llm/templates/deciderActionQuestions.template"); variable.set(Name: variable = %actionQuestions%, Value: item = %!data%)
llm.decider(State: text = "%state%", Question: dict = %actionQuestions%); variable.set(Name: variable = %actionAnswer%, Value: item = %!data%)
goal.call(Name: goal = "/system/builder/EmitBuildEvent", Parameter: list = {kind: text = "goal-decided", goal: item = %goal%})
file.read(Path: path = "orders/%orderId%.json"); variable.set(Name: variable = %order%, Value: item = %!data%)
list.count(ListName: variable = %order.items%); variable.set(Name: variable = %itemCount%, Value: item = %!data%)

text: if %itemCount% is 0, write out "Your cart is empty", else if %itemCount% is 1, write out "One item", else write out "%itemCount% items"
formal: condition.if(Left: item = %itemCount%, Operator: choice<operator> = "==", Right: number = 0) { output.write(Data: text = "Your cart is empty") }; condition.elseif(Left: item = %itemCount%, Operator: choice<operator> = "==", Right: number = 1) { output.write(Data: text = "One item") }; condition.else() { output.write(Data: text = "%itemCount% items") }
untyped: condition.if(Left=%itemCount%, Operator="==", Right=0) { output.write(Data="Your cart is empty") }; condition.elseif(Left=%itemCount%, Operator="==", Right=1) { output.write(Data="One item") }; condition.else() { output.write(Data="%itemCount% items") }

text: if %order.email% does not contain "@", throw "Invalid email address"
formal: condition.if(Left: item = %order.email%, Operator: choice<operator> = "notcontains", Right: text = "@") { error.throw(Message: text = "Invalid email address") }
untyped: condition.if(Left=%order.email%, Operator="notcontains", Right="@") { error.throw(Message="Invalid email address") }

text: if %order.coupon% is not empty, call ApplyCoupon code=%order.coupon%, order=%order%
formal: condition.if(Left: item = %order.coupon%, Operator: choice<operator> = "isnotempty") { goal.call(Name: goal = "ApplyCoupon", Parameter: list = {code: item = %order.coupon%, order: item = %order%}) }

text: if %order.total% is not a number, throw "The total must be a number"

child.text: throw "The total must be a number"

property.name: Message
property.value: The total must be a number

formal: condition.if(Left: item = %order.total%, Operator: choice<operator> = "isnot", Right: text = "number") { error.throw(Message: text = "The total must be a number") }
untyped: condition.if(Left=%order.total%, Operator="isnot", Right="number") { error.throw(Message="The total must be a number") }

formal: condition.if(Left: item = %order.country%, Operator: choice<operator> = "==", Right: text = "IS") { variable.set(Name: variable = %vat%, Value: number = 0.24) }; condition.else() { variable.set(Name: variable = %vat%, Value: number = 0.25) }
untyped: condition.if(Left=%order.country%, Operator="==", Right="IS") { variable.set(Name=%vat%, Value=0.24) }; condition.else() { variable.set(Name=%vat%, Value=0.25) }

formal: math.multiply(A: item = %order.total%, B: item = %vat%); variable.set(Name: variable = %vatAmount%, Value: item = %!data%)

text: if %order.note% does not start with "#", add %order.note% to %notes%
formal: condition.if(Left: item = %order.note%, Operator: choice<operator> = "notstartswith", Right: text = "#") { list.add(ListName: variable = %notes%, Value: item = %order.note%) }
output.write(Data: text = "Total: %order.total%, VAT: %vatAmount%")

text: list files in '/logs', pattern "*.log", write to %files%
formal: file.list(Path: path = "/logs", Pattern: text = "*.log"); variable.set(Name: variable = %files%, Value: item = %!data%)
variable.set(Name: variable = %errors%, Value: list = [])
loop.foreach(Collection: item = %files%); goal.call(Name: goal = "ScanFile", Parameter: list = {file: item = %item%})
condition.if(Left: item = %errors%, Operator: choice<operator> = "isempty")
output.write(Data: text = "No errors this week")
goal.return()
condition.if(Left: item = %files%, Operator: choice<operator> = "is", Right: text = "list")
output.write(Data: text = "Scanned the log files")
ui.render(Template: text = "report.html", Parameter: list = {errors: item = %errors%}); variable.set(Name: variable = %html%, Value: item = %!data%)
file.save(Path: path = "/reports/week.html", Value: item = %html%)

text: call SendReport to="ops@example.com", subject="Weekly report", on error call LogFailure
formal: goal.call(Name: goal = "SendReport", Parameter: list = {to: text = "ops@example.com", subject: text = "Weekly report"}); on.error(Recovery: list<action> = [goal.call(Name: goal = "LogFailure")])
output.write(Data: text = "Report sent", channel: text = "log")
variable.set(Name: variable = %template%, Value: text = "/system/error/%error.status.code%.txt")

text: render %template%, error=%error%, on error 404 call Fallback then retry once, write to %text%
formal: ui.render(Template: text = "%template%", Parameter: list = {error: item = %error%}); on.error(Status: status = 404, RetryCount: number = 1, Order: choice<errororder> = "GoalFirst", Recovery: list<action> = [goal.call(Name: goal = "Fallback")]); variable.set(Name: variable = %text%, Value: item = %!data%)
untyped: ui.render(Template="%template%", Parameter={error: %error%}); on.error(Status=404, RetryCount=1, Order="GoalFirst", Recovery=[goal.call(Name="Fallback")]); variable.set(Name=%text%, Value=%!data%)
